cl_opi_loperamide_heart.q: Is it dangerous to take loperamide (Imodium) to get through opioid withdrawal?
cl_opi_loperamide_heart.short: It can be: some people who took very large amounts got serious heart-rhythm problems.
cl_opi_loperamide_heart.but: These were only people ill enough to see a poisons doctor, and there was no group to compare with, so nobody knows how often it happens.
how: Doctors who treat poisonings in the USA described 26 people who got ill after taking loperamide.
Some took it to stop withdrawal, some to feel good, and a few were young children who swallowed it by accident.
About 4 in 10 had a change in heart rhythm that can lead to a dangerous heartbeat; some needed a breathing tube or a pacemaker, and none died.
The heart problems were in people who had taken far more than the packet says.

cl_opi_loperamide_withdrawal.q: Does loperamide help with opioid withdrawal?
cl_opi_loperamide_withdrawal.short: Nobody knows yet: the one study we read only counted people who became ill.
cl_opi_loperamide_withdrawal.but: No study we read compared people who took loperamide for withdrawal with people who did not, or with withdrawal medicines.
how: The study looked at 26 people who saw a poisons doctor after taking loperamide.
Six of them had taken it to avoid withdrawal.
The doctors wrote down heart and breathing problems, not whether the withdrawal felt better.

cl_opi_constipation_medicines.q: Do medicines for constipation caused by opioids work?
cl_opi_constipation_medicines.short: Yes: compared with a dummy pill, more people started going to the toilet normally again.
cl_opi_constipation_medicines.but: The trials were in people taking opioids for pain, not people using heroin or on methadone or buprenorphine.
how: 27 trials gave people either a medicine or a dummy pill, chosen by chance.
About 52 in 100 got better on a medicine, against 33 in 100 on the dummy pill.
Medicines that block opioids in the gut worked better than the prescription laxative lubiprostone.
Diarrhoea and tummy pain were more common on the medicines, and a few more people stopped taking them because of side effects.

cl_opi_constipation_otc_laxatives.q: Do ordinary laxatives from the shop help constipation caused by opioids?
cl_opi_constipation_otc_laxatives.short: We can't say yet: the review we read did not test shop-bought laxatives.
cl_opi_constipation_otc_laxatives.but: Its authors say the older studies of these laxatives are hard to judge, and we have not read those studies yet.
how: The review only included medicines that need a doctor's prescription.
Its authors say people often try ordinary laxatives first.
They think prescription laxatives may not work better than shop ones, but they did not test this.

cl_opi_methadone_withdrawal_between_dose.q: Why do some people on methadone feel withdrawal before their next dose?
cl_opi_methadone_withdrawal_between_dose.short: In one small study, their methadone level dropped faster after its daily high point.
cl_opi_methadone_withdrawal_between_dose.but: Only 18 people were tested for one day, and the difference was clear only after two people were left out.
how: Nine people who felt withdrawal before their next dose were compared with nine who did not.
Just before the dose, both groups had about the same level of methadone in their blood.
In everyone, withdrawal was lowest in the hours after the dose and grew as the level fell.
The study did not test any change to treatment.

cl_pop_eye_damage.short: Yes, in some people: reports describe blurry central vision and damage at the back of the eye.
cl_pop_eye_damage.but: These are reports of people who went to an eye doctor, so they cannot tell how often it happens or which poppers do it.
how: Eye doctors in at least 12 countries have written about 113 people with eye problems after poppers, some after using them once.
Most had both eyes affected: blurry or dim vision in the middle, flashes of light, or a blank spot.
Scans showed damage to the light-sensing cells right in the centre of the eye.
Of the people who had a second scan, about 6 in 10 had got better or fully recovered.

cl_pop_eye_stopping.q: If poppers have hurt my eyes, does stopping them or taking lutein help?
cl_pop_eye_stopping.short: Nobody knows: people were told to stop, but no one compared them with people who didn't.
cl_pop_eye_stopping.but: Only 27 of the 113 people were checked on whether they really stopped, and just five were given lutein.
how: Eye doctors told most people with this damage to stop using poppers.
Five people were given lutein, a supplement, with or without stopping.
Many people's eyes got better over time, but the reports cannot show whether stopping was the reason.
One man who kept using stayed the same, and one whose stopping was not recorded got better.
